name: Il Borro
positioning: Thousand-year-old Tuscan hamlet restored by the Ferragamo family, now a Relais & Chateaux estate with an organic winery, villas and suites in the medieval village
best_for: Wine lovers who want tastings, vineyard itineraries and the old barrique cellar on the estate
Families who want cooking classes, riding lessons and children's activities in one place
Travelers who want a countryside base for guided tours to Florence, Siena and Chianti

facts.text: Il Borro was a fortress in the 12th century.
In 1993 Duke Amedeo di Savoia-Aosta ceded ownership to Ferruccio Ferragamo, who promoted a restoration of the estate.
Il Borro is in the heart of Valdarno di Sopra, a natural basin bordered by the Pratomagno ridge.
Il Borro is part of Relais & Chateaux.
Accommodation includes the Dimora Storica, Villa Casetta, suites within the medieval village and suites at Aie del Borro.
Il Borro has been certified organic since 2015.
More than 100 beehives are located on the estate.
The estate has trails, bike routes, tennis, soccer and golf.
Craft workshops let guests take part in making small handmade pieces.
Cooking classes are designed for adults and children.
Children's activities can be done with parents or supervised by a professional babysitter.
Osteria del Borro offers a gourmet menu and Il Borro Tuscan Bistro a more traditional menu.

highlights.text: Il Borro is a thousand-year-old hamlet in the heart of Tuscany.
Villa Mulino is immersed in the woods and Villa Casetta sits among the Merlot vineyards.
Wine experiences include tastings, the Wine & Art Gallery, vineyard itineraries and visits to the old barrique cellar.
The estate has 85 hectares of vineyards between 300 and 500 meters above sea level.
Il Borro offers horseback riding lessons for experienced riders and beginners.

considerations.text: The I Borrigiani farmhouses are 1.5 km from the main facility and services.
Guided tours visit Florence, San Gimignano, Volterra, Siena and the Chianti area.
WhataHotel notes the countryside location requires a rental car for exploring beyond the estate.

sources.title: Il Borro - The estate and its history
